disposition_reason: Tables 3 to 5 print per-sample iron, zinc, manganese, cadmium and chromium (dry weight) and group means and ranges on a fresh-weight basis for 12 local and imported honeys from Dhaka; lead was below the LOQ in all.

study.design: Market and beekeeper survey with THQ/HI risk assessment
study.origin: Bangladesh (local) and six imported sources (countries not named)
study.market: beekeepers (LH1-LH3) and neighborhood markets of Mohammadpur, Dhaka
study.method: Oven-dried at 60-70 °C for 72 h; HNO3:H2O2 (2:1) digestion in a 90 °C water bath; flame/AAS (Analytik Jena NovAA 400P)
study.qa: Spike recoveries 95.6-104.9%; precision 1.2-6.8%; no CRM (stated as a limitation)
